name: Luna Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231884 (142 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF campground in open ponderosa pines beside Luna Lake, ~5 mi east of Alpine (elev ~7,900 ft). About 50 single sites plus group sites, no hookups, RVs to 32 ft, reservable online. Vault toilets, drinking water, boat ramp; trout fishing and boating on the lake. Summer-only (snow closes it in winter). --Claude

name: Sharp Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233898 (193 days observed, edges opens)
note: Tonto NF campground below the Mogollon Rim ~1.5 mi east of Christopher Creek at ~6,000 ft; 28 sites in 3 loops (family/tent/group), 17 sites fit RVs/trailers 25 ft and up; 19 sites reservable, 9 first-come first-served. Trout fishing on nearby Christopher/Sharp Creek. --Claude

name: Ponderosa Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234563 (190 days observed, edges opens)
note: Tonto NF on AZ-260 E of Payson (Rim Country, ~5700 ft). 48 single sites + 2 group sites; no hookups, RVs 20-40 ft, drive-in paved loops in pine forest. Seasonal (spring-fall); reservable online. --Claude

name: Schoolhouse Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 249291 (150 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tonto NF on the E shore of Roosevelt Lake, ~11 mi S of Roosevelt Dam. Large campground; Mesquite Loop 40 sites reservable Nov 1-Apr 30 (odd sites) / FCFS (even), more sites in the area; ramadas, paved pull-throughs, paved boat ramp. Note Roosevelt Lake drawdown — current waterline can sit well below the loops. --Claude

name: Spillway Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232203 (171 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Black Mesa RD), Mogollon Rim on Woods Canyon Lake. ~25 sites in ponderosa pine, vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. Individual sites accommodate RVs roughly 25-42 ft but the loop road is tight (rig >32 ft not recommended). Electric-motor-only lake. Reservable on recreation.gov, seasonal (about May-Sept). --Claude

name: Aspen Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232190 (146 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Black Mesa RD), Mogollon Rim near Woods Canyon Lake. Large campground (~136 sites in four loops of meadow/pine). 121 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 27 first-come-first-served. Electric-motor-only lake. --Claude

name: Sinkhole Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 256344 (146 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Black Mesa RD), ponderosa pine on Willow Springs Lake Rd (FR 149) off Hwy 260, about 1 mi from Willow Springs Lake. 26 back-in sites (14-26 reservable on recreation.gov, 1-13 FCFS). Fire ring/grill and table each site. --Claude

name: Dogtown Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233956 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Kaibab NF (Williams RD), pine forest along the shore of small Dogtown Lake SE of Williams. ~50 single sites plus 4 double and 1 group site; level pull-through and back-in sites, RVs 15-40 ft. Water faucets, restrooms, no dump station, no hookups. Reservable on recreation.gov, open about May-Oct. --Claude

name: Burnt Corral Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 249254 (264 days observed, edges closes+opens)
note: Tonto NF campground on the south shoreline of Apache Lake, ~6 mi below Roosevelt Dam off the Apache Trail (SR-88). 82 developed non-electric sites (concrete/compacted-gravel pads, low grades); motorhomes to ~32 ft, towed trailers to 22 ft; potable water, vault toilets, boat ramp, dump station ~5 mi away. Reservable via Recreation.gov Nov 1-Mar 15, first-come first-served Mar 16-Oct 31. --Claude

name: Grayling Campground (Big Lake)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232196 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF campground at Big Lake in the White Mountains (~9,000 ft), forested in ponderosa/fir/spruce/aspen. 23 sites on one loop, fire rings/grills/tables, vault toilets, no hookups; RV dump station ~1 mi away; suited to smaller RVs (nearby Apache Trout loop takes rigs to 45 ft). Reservable on Recreation.gov. Some sites have a lake view, none directly on the water. High-elevation, snow-gated season (roughly late May-Sept). --Claude
